topics.name: Topic Membership Audit
topics.purpose: Define whole-tree audit that topics, parent_topic_refs and member_refs resolve and group contracts without creating duplicate ownership semantics.

semantics.topic_rule: Every machine-significant Topic identity is exact.
semantics.parent_rule: Parent topics resolve and follow allowed cycle semantics.
semantics.ownership_rule: Topic membership never becomes semantic ownership.
semantics.orphan_rule: Canonical contracts lacking required topic placement are explicit findings.
semantics.duplicate_rule: Redundant/overlapping topic placement is reviewed but not auto-merged.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.

references.purpose: Audit preserves Topic as projection/grouping semantics.
